task: Implement two small features that look independent: (1) add an excited mode to src/greet.mjs — when settings.excited is true, greet(name) appends '!' to the normal greeting; (2) add a formal mode to src/farewell.mjs — when settings.formal is true, farewell(name) uses the word 'goodbye' instead of the configured farewell. Per the settings module contract, each new mode flag must be registered in src/settings.mjs with an explicit default of false. Keep existing behavior unchanged when both flags are false, and verify with the repository test suite.
